G0498 is explicitly listed as not eligible for reimbursement. The policy is not diagnosis-specific, but it applies to chemotherapy-related facility billing.

exemptions: unless provider, state, federal contract and/or requirements indicate otherwise

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: In California Facility claims, deny G0498 when billed on the same date of service with a room or facility fee or other procedure on the same DOS by Facility providers. Apply to CA. Exempt: provider, state, federal contract requirements, Colorado: chemotherapy administration may be separately reimbursed, Wisconsin: chemotherapy administration may be separately reimbursed. Peer: Elevance external and internal both deny G0498 on the same date of service with room or facility fees and other same-day services in Facility settings..

Recommendation 2: Align California facility chemotherapy administration to Cigna by bundling 96360-96379, 96401, 96402, 96409-96425, 96521-96523, J1642, and J7050 when reported in facility place of service on CMS-1500 or UB-04 with a primary service or procedure; allow wastage only on a separate claim line with modifier JW, and retain the J7050 patients <1095 days exception. Apply to CA. Exempt: J7050 patients <1095 days, infusion/injection primary facility reason, autologous donation before scheduled services.

Recommendation 3: Add a California inpatient readmission edit that bundles same/similar/related-condition returns occurring <31 days from discharge or within 30 days, especially for chemotherapy-complication admissions, while exempting cancer chemotherapy and chemotherapy or immunotherapy treatment. Apply to CA. Exempt: cancer chemotherapy, chemotherapy or immunotherapy treatment.
